fusions.name: Silverside Glints
fusions.desc: Looses 3 glints at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds, its dodge chance lowered.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 18 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Slick Scales
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Prey Pattern
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you have 12% more dodge chance.
